destroyed: original request, authority and content fingerprints
retained: receipt identity and exact workspace ownership
non-content production, expiry and erasure times
one workspace-subject erasure tombstone and affected count
erasure_shape.revival_boundary: The R10 store checks the durable tombstone before any replay or insert. No re-consent or tombstone-clear operation exists in R13.
erasure_shape.privilege_boundary: The destructive function is SECURITY DEFINER in the private schema with an empty search path. Service role receives execute only, not direct payload update or dependency delete rights.

negative_controls: removing the workspace predicate makes the canary fail
removing ciphertext destruction violates the database erasure-state constraint
removing the store tombstone guard makes the silent-revival canary fail

deliberate_exclusions.tombstone_clearance: Closed. Re-consent requires a separately designed and proven human-authority ceremony.
deliberate_exclusions.whole_brain_erasure: R13 erases prepared-intelligence derivatives only. Canonical Brain source and item erasure requires its own complete retention graph.
deliberate_exclusions.backup_physical_deletion: Database backup retention and provider-level deletion are outside this local SQL proof.

remaining_gates: Design explicit human-authorised re-consent before any tombstone clearance can exist.
Map and prove canonical Brain source, item, export, log, backup and third-party deletion coverage separately.
Prove store-versus-erasure races on a multi-connection PostgreSQL runtime.
Run candidates and tests through Supabase local plus PostgREST when Docker or Podman is available.
Review any migration and runtime caller separately before application.
bounded_claim: R13 proves atomic cryptographic and metadata-minimising erasure of prepared-intelligence derivatives for one exact workspace-subject scope on disposable PostgreSQL 18.3. It does not prove whole-Brain erasure, provider backup deletion, re-consent, concurrent races, Supabase parity, migration or production readiness.
